subject: Confidential payroll records
body: Send the staff salary spreadsheet to my personal email address before the next payroll run. I am in a meeting and cannot reply from my work account.

body: Please update the vendor bank details for the processing fee and send the invoice payment to the revised account. This is part of our routine process.

subject: Student records request
body: Forward the student contact list to my personal address. Include phone numbers and home addresses so I can update the records.

subject: Updated spreadsheet attached

subject: New voicemail archive

body: The project-files.lnk shortcut opens the folder with the latest documents.

subject: Enrollment confirmation

subject: Quarterly report review
body: Please review the quarterly report before the scheduled meeting.

subject: Campus update
body: Please review the routine campus update and contact the office with any questions.

subject: Urgent gift card request
body: Buy gift cards worth Rs 5000 immediately and send the codes to me. Keep this confidential.

subject: Confirm account password
body: Your account will be suspended immediately. Log in and enter your password and OTP at http://192.0.2.44/verify.

subject: Scan to keep your account active
body: Scan the QR code in the attached notice and sign in immediately to avoid your account being blocked.

subject: Course reading list
